title: A new operator learning fulfilment and this application
provenance: Synthetic persona, revised after the owner's reported first-use confusion on 2026-09-23. It does not establish how common these difficulties are.
summary: You have just started handling orders at a small shop and are learning both fulfilment and this application.
goals: Finish the work that can safely be completed.
Understand what remains blocked and what to do next.
Be able to explain and reverse a change you approved.
knowledge: You understand ordinary shopping terms such as an address, available stock, and agreeing to a replacement.
You can read the customer messages and order information available in the application.
unfamiliarWith: The application's navigation and status terminology.
How the embedded assistant's suggestions become changes to orders.
Which fulfilment steps remain after you review and accept a change.
constraints: Use only the visible application and help available to a normal user.
Ask a follow-up when an answer does not give enough information to act.
Describe confusion only when something you observed caused it.
